canon.note: Enkindle the First Lodestar (151001, Basic): single-target. Upraise the Vanward Cresset (151002, Skill): no damage; recovers all Assist Skill uses, grants Navigator's Semaphore for #2 = 3 turns (all allies +DMG). We, Too, Stride the Stars (151003, Ultimate): Starblazer performs Hyperluminal Particle Beam (151008, #1 = 32% AoE per use, +1 Source Energy, max #3 = 2... engine cap differs) or Orbital Annihilation Pulse (151009: consumes 1 Source Energy, #9 = 762% designated / #10 = 252% others; with Source Energy > 1, every #2 points consumed add 1 random-enemy instance of #3); when Beam uses run out, launches Pulse then Final Hit (#6 = 3 instances of #7 = 80% on random enemies). 151008 notes: a cycle = 3 animations, 2nd use per cycle dealt in 4 hits of 25%. 151009 notes: bounce DMG before AoE DMG. Of Fire and Far Faring (151004, Talent): deploys Starblazer Visioscape, grants allies 1 Assist Skill use; Assist Skill considered as Nova using her Skill. The Silver Rail (Trace): on Ultimate gain 3 Source Energy; at >= 3 Source Energy the Pulse multiplier against random single enemies +30% (-> bounce instances 30% -> 39%). Companion Protocol: Verdict (151025, Assist Skill): only usable via another ally's Assist Skill slot.

fixtures.env: Himeko • Nova E0 solo vs 3 Fire-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: We, Too, Stride the Stars (151003) is Nova's Ultimate action (2 casts in the fixture).
Upraise the Vanward Cresset (151002) is her Skill action (3 casts in the fixture; no damage).
Enkindle the First Lodestar (151001) is her Basic ATK action (2 casts in the fixture).
Enkindle the First Lodestar hits its single target once per cast (2 events).
Each Ultimate's Starblazer cycle lands Orbital Annihilation Pulse (151009) on all 3 enemies at use slots 1, 2, 3, 5 and final: 6 events per slot label per slot (2 casts x 3 enemies).
Pulse use slot 2/6: 6 events (2 casts x 3 enemies).
Pulse use slot 3/6: 6 events.
Pulse use slot 5/6: 6 events.
The terminal Orbital Annihilation Pulse (auto-launched when Beam uses are depleted, 151003) fires once per Ultimate on all 3 enemies: 6 events.
Hyperluminal Particle Beam (151008) at use slot 4/6: 6 events (2 casts x 3 enemies).
Hyperluminal Particle Beam at use slot 6/6: 6 events.
Final Hit (151003 #6 = 3 instances of 80% vs random enemies) lands 3 instances per Ultimate: 6 events total.
The Silver Rail boosts one Pulse bounce instance per Ultimate (>= 3 Source Energy): 2 events labelled '(Source Energy)' on slot 1/6.
Unboosted Source Energy bounce instances land on slot 2/6: 2 events.
Talent (151004): Nova ignores Weakness Types when attacking — 1 Weakness Break in the fixture.
Companion Protocol: Verdict (151025, Assist Skill) never activates in a solo fixture — Assist Skills require another ally's slot.
The Basic ATK regenerates 1 Skill Point per cast (2 casts = 2 SP).
The Skill costs 1 Skill Point per cast (3 casts = 3 SP).
Enkindle the First Lodestar at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (151001) totals 100% of ATK.
Orbital Annihilation Pulse (151009 #10) deals 252% of ATK to other targets.
Hyperluminal Particle Beam (151003 #1) deals 32% of ATK per use.
Final Hit instance multiplier (151003 #7) is 80% of ATK.
The Silver Rail: bounce instance 30% + 30% boost at >= 3 Source Energy = 39% of ATK.
Source Energy bounce instance (151009) base multiplier is 30% of ATK.
Over the fixture Nova gains exactly 230 Energy (ENERGY_GAIN sum; both Ultimates consume their full gauge).
Navigator's Semaphore (151002) lasts #2 = 3 turns.
The cycle order: Pulse slots 1-3 fire before the Beam at slot 4.
